> Exzelon is a Chicago-based recruitment and staffing agency that connects skilled
> professionals with employers across five industries: Healthcare, Construction,
> Electrical, Tax & Legal, and Information Technology. Principal office: 6422 N
> Maplewood Ave, Chicago, Illinois 60645, USA. Phone: +1 (872) 358-0100.
> Email: contactus@exzelon.com. Searching, creating a profile, and applying are
> always free for job seekers; employer partners fund the services.

## About

- [About Exzelon](https://www.exzelon.com/about): Mission, vision, values, and approach to recruitment.
- [For Clients](https://www.exzelon.com/for-clients): How employers engage Exzelon for recruitment, staffing, direct hire, and workforce administration.
- [Contact](https://www.exzelon.com/contact): Enquiries for job seekers and employers.

## Opportunities by Industry

- [Healthcare Staffing](https://www.exzelon.com/opportunities/healthcare): Registered nurses, LPNs, travel nurses, allied health, and clinical support.
- [Construction Staffing](https://www.exzelon.com/opportunities/construction): Site supervisors, project managers, and skilled trades.
- [Electrical Staffing](https://www.exzelon.com/opportunities/electrical): Journeyman and master electricians, industrial and controls technicians, field engineers.
- [Tax & Legal Staffing](https://www.exzelon.com/opportunities/tax-legal): CPAs, tax accountants, paralegals, compliance analysts, and corporate counsel.
- [IT Staffing](https://www.exzelon.com/opportunities/it): Software engineers, data analysts, cloud/DevOps engineers, and QA.
- [Browse All Jobs](https://www.exzelon.com/jobs): Live job board with search, location, industry, and salary filters.

## Resources

- [FAQ](https://www.exzelon.com/resources/faq): Common questions from job seekers and employers — cost, industries, placement process, travel assignments, and compliance.
- [Compliance Standards](https://www.exzelon.com/resources/compliance): License verification, background screening, credentialing, right-to-work, OSHA, and data protection.
- [Blog — Career & Hiring Guides](https://www.exzelon.com/resources/blog): Articles on job searching, resume writing, the U.S. job market, and employer hiring strategy.

## Key Facts (for AI context)

- Job seekers use Exzelon free of charge; employer partners fund the services.
- Sectors served: Healthcare, Construction, Electrical, Tax & Legal, and Information Technology.
- Assignment types: full-time, contract, temp-to-hire, part-time, and travel (with housing and logistics support for travelers).
- Every candidate is credentialed and compliance-checked before placement.
- Headquartered in Chicago, Illinois; places candidates in the Chicago metro and nationally.
